Pregnancy in Israel – Sharing is Caring! 💕

I've seen many posts lately from expecting parents looking for information, so I wanted to share a few things I've learned during my pregnancy journey.

**Hospital Tours in English**
• Ichilov: [https://www.tasmc.org.il/lis/mamy-lis/events/multi-lingual-guided-tours-at-lis/](https://www.tasmc.org.il/lis/mamy-lis/events/multi-lingual-guided-tours-at-lis/)
• Tel Hashomer: [https://lp.sheba.co.il/%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99-%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%93%D7%94?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=tours_Search&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22181505585&gbraid=0AAAAAq9lSP_y6kZ4ewdcJZpGyBYMaNaRs&gclid=CjwKCAjw0o3SBhBVEiwAh28-jUF_d0FMdnLJG3n4ZwBbmKJieMSe9yJ1iZbuSyTMHfSN4Cfpvi_1ABoCfBcQAvD_BwE](https://lp.sheba.co.il/%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99-%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%93%D7%94?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=tours_Search&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22181505585&gbraid=0AAAAAq9lSP_y6kZ4ewdcJZpGyBYMaNaRs&gclid=CjwKCAjw0o3SBhBVEiwAh28-jUF_d0FMdnLJG3n4ZwBbmKJieMSe9yJ1iZbuSyTMHfSN4Cfpvi_1ABoCfBcQAvD_BwE)
• Wolfson (private tours can be arranged via WhatsApp, although the staff generally does not speak English)

**Pregnancy & Parenting Courses in English**
From my experience, Tel Hashomer does not currently offer childbirth classes in English and usually refers parents to English-speaking doulas for private sessions.

Ichilov offers a variety of English courses, including:
• Childbirth Preparation, Breastfeeding Workshop, CPR for Babies & Toddlers, Nutrition During Pregnancy, and more!

Link: [https://www.tasmc.org.il/lis/mamy-lis/courses/courses-parents/](https://www.tasmc.org.il/lis/mamy-lis/courses/courses-parents/)
Phone: 03-697-3113  Email: Mamylis-Crm@tlvmc.gov.il

They answer the phone quickly and are very helpful in English.

**Medical Circumcision (Brit Milah)**
I have a list of recommended doctors. Feel free to PM me if you'd like the details, as my list contains personal phone numbers.

**Mama's in Israel Facebook Groups**
• **ImaKadima: Working & Career-Minded Moms in Israel** – Great for job opportunities, networking, and career advice.

• **Mamas in Israel - Pregnancy | Birth | Early Parenting** – A wonderful resource for pregnancy, birth, and early parenting support. They also have a website and WhatsApp group: https://www.mamasinisrael.com/

**Family Visiting New Moms in Israel **
**- ***If you have more information regarding this topic, please share* 😊**-**

I checked the official website and these are the documents I found (so far) that are needed:

• ETA-IL (Electronic Travel Authorization valid for a stay up to 90 days per visit) **before boarding the flight to Israel**
• Paperwork from me: my **Teudat Zeut** (and my husband’s), plus an **invitation letter from both of us** including the visitor’s passport details and our address
• **Return ticket**
• **Proof of sufficient funds** for the trip (we include this in the invitation letter)

Hope this helps another mama-to-be! 💕
